chat_add_placeholder: Add a chat: channel or link
chat_empty:
No chat open.
Type a channel name or paste a Twitch, Kick or Steam TV link above.
chat_bad_channel: Channel name or link not recognized
chat_cleared: The chat was cleared by a moderator.
chat_input_login: Read-only — log in to {platform} to write
chat_hint_emotes: Emotes from popular extensions, loaded from their servers (Twitch; 7TV for Kick too).
chat_hint_highlights: Messages that mention your username or these words are highlighted, and the tab shows it.
chat_hint_twitch_app: Create an application on dev.twitch.tv (Chat Bot category, "Public" type, redirect URL http://localhost) and paste its Client ID. Click here to open it.
chat_hint_kick_app: Create a Kick application (Settings › Developer) with the redirect URL {redirect} and the "read user info" and "write to chat" scopes. Click here to open it.
chat_device_intro: A Twitch page has opened. Enter this code there, then authorize Streamlink Chat:
chat_device_wait: Waiting for authorization… Close this panel to cancel.
chat_login_browser: Authorize the application in the page that just opened
chat_login_browser_done: Logged in. You can close this tab and go back to Streamlink Chat.
chat_hint_watch: The ▶ button starts the stream with Streamlink, in the player set in its configuration (VLC by default).
hint_update_check: Compares your version with the latest one published on GitHub.
hint_auto_update: At start-up, downloads, checks and installs the new version, then restarts Streamlink Chat. Needs "Check for updates at start-up" and the Windows executable (.exe).
toast_app_up_to_date: Streamlink Chat is up to date
toast_update_page_opened: Download page opened in your browser
confirm_app_update:
Download and install version {latest}?
Streamlink Chat will restart.
chat_hint_platform_colors: Tints the chat and its tabs with their platform's color (Twitch purple, Kick green, Steam TV navy).
